# Platform sync, October 14

Attendees: Dana, Luis, Priyanka, Owen.

- Luis reported that the new ingestion path is faster then the old one by about 40% on the benchmark set. the team agreed to switch the default next sprint.

- Priyanka is blocked on the Kafka upgrade until the ops team confirms the broker version.

- Owen will write the runbook for the new alert before it goes live.

Next sync is October 21. Dana to send the agenda by Friday.
